assumptions.statement: Overall and three key-area polygons remain rough provisional geometry, not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All areas, ratios, dependent layers, figures, HTML and PDFs require coordinated recalculation when authoritative GIS is supplied.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, heritage, utilities, fire access and service-capacity controls are incomplete or unavailable in the package.
assumptions.impact: The work is a reviewable conceptual open-call design and cannot support statutory, engineering, land, investment or approval conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Land use, buildings, green/public space, roads, phasing, prototypes and scenario nodes are participant-authored design geometry inside a provisional boundary.
assumptions.impact: Derived ratios and counts describe this submission only; they are neither existing-condition measurements nor approved targets.

assumptions.statement: The 108 m comparison segment, 8.4 m total band, 2.8 m human spine, 36 m bay interval and three prototype placements are concept geometry used to compare alternatives.
assumptions.impact: Field survey, accessibility audit, fire/traffic review, ownership, utilities, heritage consultation and public participation must replace these dimensions before any site design.

assumptions.statement: First 100 Days, six-role RACI, three resource bands, eight implementation packages and twelve-month programme are suggested governance architecture.
assumptions.impact: They do not assert a funded programme, named government duty, approved schedule, procurement, operator appointment or maintenance commitment.

assumptions.statement: No on-site survey, stakeholder interview, accessibility audit, device trial or real-user test was conducted for v2.0.
assumptions.impact: Human-scale conflicts, user priorities, demand, rain/night/peak conditions, safety, accessibility, cost and maintenance feasibility remain field-unknown.

assumptions.statement: The 12 scenario contracts and 84 fixtures are offline deterministic tests: one normal plus six negative cases per scenario, with no people, site, device, model endpoint or public-service operation.
assumptions.impact: The 84/84 and 72/72 results demonstrate only contract coverage and fail-closed code behaviour; they are not safety, accessibility, reliability, usefulness or implementation evidence.

assumptions.statement: Five 2026 official public pages establish relevant public-space, AI Origin visitor/learning, Haidian testbed and Qinghuayuan heritage contexts.
assumptions.impact: They orient design questions but do not provide site redlines, survey, operating authority, public consent, project approval or reusable visual assets.

assumptions.statement: Resource bands L1/L2/L3 express relative delivery complexity only; no currency estimate or funding source is claimed.
assumptions.impact: A professional quantity, procurement, lifecycle and maintenance assessment is required after site, scope and operator are authorised.
